name: Divorce Forgiveness
overview: Scripture reveals God's clear stance against divorce, expressing His hatred for putting away a spouse except in cases of sexual immorality, as taught in Malachi 2:16 and Matthew 19:9. Jesus acknowledges the reality of divorce but emphasizes the sanctity of marriage and the seriousness of remarriage after divorce. At the same time, the Bible calls believers to extend forgiveness to others, as illustrated in Matthew 6:14 and 18:21, reminding us that God’s forgiveness toward us is connected to our willingness to forgive. Ultimately, all sins, including those related to broken relationships, can be forgiven through Christ, as Mark 3:28 affirms.
